metric: Five-frame PINNS top-mode ADE in metres, M1 minus constant velocity. Negative favors M1.

method.sampling: Unstratified paired resampling of nonempty clips with replacement, each clip equally likely. Each replicate draws the original number of clips and retains every paired window inside each selected clip.
method.generator: NumPy PCG64, source clip names sorted lexicographically
method.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of bootstrap estimates, linear interpolation.
method.input_precision: Source clip/model means are rounded to six decimal places in metres.

scope: Post-hoc comparison on the original V2 split reused during development. M1's five-seed average is held fixed throughout.
The bootstrap approximates independent clips and retains dependence within clips. Correlation between clips from a shared site may remain.
The observations cover four fixed locations. The intervals describe clip resampling on this observed pool and do not estimate transfer to new sites.
